PDF to PPT Converter - Chrome Extension for Windows
==================================================

VERSION: 1.0.0
PLATFORM: Windows 7/8/10/11 with Chrome 88+
PACKAGE DATE: December 2024

QUICK START:
-----------
1. Extract all files to a folder on your computer
2. Navigate to the "windows-installer" folder
3. Right-click "install-extension.bat" and "Run as administrator"
4. Choose option [3] "Install via Developer Mode"
5. Follow the on-screen instructions

WHAT'S INCLUDED:
---------------
- extension-package/     - The Chrome extension files
- windows-installer/     - Installation and management scripts
- WINDOWS_INSTALLATION_GUIDE.md - Complete installation guide

INSTALLATION SCRIPTS:
--------------------
- install-extension.bat     - Main installer (run this first)
- create-crx.bat           - Creates .crx package file
- uninstall-extension.bat  - Removes the extension

REQUIREMENTS:
------------
- Windows 7, 8, 10, or 11
- Google Chrome browser (latest version recommended)
- 2GB+ RAM (4GB+ recommended for large PDFs)
- 50MB+ free disk space
- Internet connection (for initial setup)

FEATURES:
---------
- Convert PDF files to PowerPoint presentations
- Smart text extraction and formatting
- Automatic PDF detection on web pages
- Customizable conversion options
- Beautiful modern interface
- Local processing (no data sent to servers)

SUPPORT:
--------
For detailed instructions, see:
- WINDOWS_INSTALLATION_GUIDE.md (complete guide)
- extension-package/README.md (technical documentation)
- extension-package/test_extension.md (testing guide)

TROUBLESHOOTING:
---------------
If you encounter issues:
1. Ensure Chrome is properly installed
2. Run installer as administrator
3. Check that all files are extracted
4. Disable antivirus temporarily if blocked
5. Use manual installation method if automated fails

For more help, check the documentation files included in this package.

SECURITY:
---------
This extension:
- Processes files locally on your computer
- Does not send data to external servers
- Uses standard Chrome extension APIs
- Is safe to install and use

Windows Defender may flag the .bat files as potentially harmful.
This is normal for batch scripts. Add the folder to exclusions if needed.

UPDATES:
--------
To update the extension:
1. Download the new version
2. Extract to the same folder (overwrite)
3. Run install-extension.bat again

---
Thank you for using PDF to PPT Converter!
For questions or support, refer to the documentation included in this package.
